from tinydb import TinyDB
from tinydb.storages import MemoryStorage
from tinydb.journal import BatchWriter

db = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
w = BatchWriter(db)

# Test R05: preview doesn't consume IDs
ops = [{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}}, {'op': 'insert', 'document': {'y': 2}}]
preview1 = w.preview(ops)
print(f'preview1={preview1}')
assert preview1 == [1, 2]
assert len(db) == 0

# Preview again should give same IDs
preview2 = w.preview(ops)
print(f'preview2={preview2}')
assert preview2 == [1, 2]
assert len(db) == 0

# After apply, next ID should be 3
result = w.apply(ops)
print(f'apply result={result}')
assert result == [1, 2]
assert len(db) == 2

# Now preview should give [3, 4]
preview3 = w.preview(ops)
print(f'preview3={preview3}')
assert preview3 == [3, 4]

# Test R05: failed apply doesn't consume IDs
ops2 = [{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'z': 3}}, {'op': 'remove', 'doc_id': 999}]
try:
    w.apply(ops2)
    print('FAIL: should have raised')
except ValueError:
    pass

# Next preview should still start at 5
preview4 = w.preview([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'a': 1}}])
print(f'preview4={preview4}')
assert preview4 == [5]
print('PASS: failed apply did not consume IDs')
